entries.Original:
Opens the Artisan menu.
/artisan lists → Open Lists.
/artisan lists <ID> → Opens specific list by ID.
/artisan lists <ID> start → Starts specific list by ID.
/artisan macros → Open Macros.
/artisan macros <ID> → Opens specific macro by ID.
/artisan endurance → Open Endurance.
/artisan endurance start|stop → Starts or stops endurance mode.
/artisan settings → Open Settings.
/artisan workshops → Open FC Workshops.
/artisan builder → Open List Builder.
/artisan automode → Toggles Automatic Action Execution Mode on/off.

entries.Original:
This has been reworked! Having this enabled will adjust all quantities in your list rather than just removing unrequired crafts. It will now also add more crafts where required. It will also sort the list afterwards to make sure it's crafting in the right order in case you have removed items.

Quick disclaimer: This will treat whatever item you have selected as a "Final Craft" and only adjust sub-crafts required for that item, and not anything this item may be used for e.g changing lumber won't update crafts that use that lumber.
entries.Translated:
这已经被重新设计了！启用此功能后，它会调整您列表中的所有数量，而不仅仅是移除不需要的工艺品。现在它还会在需要的地方添加更多工艺品。它还会在之后对列表进行排序，以确保在您移除项目时，工艺品的制作顺序是正确的。

快速免责声明：这将把你选择的任何物品视为 “最终工艺”，并且只会调整该物品所需的子工艺，而不会调整该物品可能用于的任何东西，例如更换木材不会更新使用该木材的工艺。

entries.Original: This will sort your list by recipe depth, then difficulty. Recipe depth is defined by how many of the ingredients depend on other recipes on the list.
entries.Translated: 这将按照食谱深度和难度对你的清单进行排序。食谱深度的定义是有多少成分依赖于清单上的其他食谱。

entries.Original: , giving this recipe a depth of 3 if all these items are on the list.
entries.Translated: 如果所有这些项目都在列表中，则该配方的深度为 3。

entries.Original: Items that do not have other recipe dependencies have a depth of 1, so go to the top of the list, e.g
entries.Translated: 没有其他配方依赖关系的项目深度为 1，所以请移到列表顶部，例如

entries.Original: Finally, this is sorted by the in-game difficulty of the crafts, hopefully grouping together similar crafts.
entries.Translated: 最后，这些技能会根据游戏内的技能难度进行排序，希望能将相似的技能组合在一起。

entries.Original: This will toggle all items in this list between being skipped and being enabled.

entries.Original: This ingredients table shows you everything needed to craft the items on your list. The basic functionality of the table shows you information such as how many of an ingredient is in your inventory, sources of an ingredient, if it has a zone it can be gathered in etc.
entries.Translated: 这个配料表向你展示了制作清单上的物品所需的一切。表格的基本功能向你展示了库存中有多少种配料、配料的来源、如果配料有区域可以在哪里收集等信息。

entries.Original: You can click on the column headers to filter the results, either through typing or on a pre-determined filter.
entries.Translated: 您可以点击列标题来过滤结果，无论是通过键入还是使用预定义的过滤器。

entries.Original: Right clicking on a header will allow you to show/hide different columns or resize columns.
entries.Translated: 右键单击标题可以显示/隐藏不同的列或调整列大小。

entries.Original: Right clicking on an ingredient name opens a context menu with further options.
entries.Translated: 右键点击配料名称，打开包含更多选项的上下文菜单。

entries.Original: Clicking and dragging on the space on the headers between columns (as shown by it lighting up) allows you to re-order the columns.
entries.Translated: 点击并拖动列标题之间的空白处 (如其亮起所示) 可以重新排列列。

entries.Original: Don't see any items? Check the table headers for a red heading. This indicates this column is being filtered on. Right clicking the header will clear the filter.
entries.Translated: 没有看到任何项目？检查表格标题是否有红色标题。这表示该列正在被过滤。右键单击标题将清除过滤器。

entries.Translated: 请在模拟器中运行这个食谱获取结果。

entries.Translated: 请安装 Allagan Tools 以获得保留功能。

entries.Original: Once you're at 100% quality, the macro will skip over all actions relating to quality, including buffs.
entries.Translated: 一旦达到 100% 质量，宏将跳过所有与质量相关的操作，包括 buff。

entries.Original: If you get a Good or Excellent condition and your macro is on a step that increases quality (not including Byregot's Blessing) then it will upgrade the action to Precise Touch.
entries.Translated: 如果你获得良好或卓越的状态，并且宏正处于提升质量的阶段 (不包括 Byregot 的祝福)，那么它会将操作升级为精准触控。

entries.Original: If you get a Good or Excellent condition and your macro is on a step that increases progress then it will upgrade the action to Intensive Synthesis.
entries.Translated: 如果你获得了良好或优秀的状态，并且宏正处于增加进度的阶段，那么它就会将行动提升为强化综合。

entries.Original: Artisan will not start crafting if you do not meet this minimum craftsmanship with this macro selected.
entries.Translated: 如果选择这个宏时未达到最低工艺要求，工匠将不会开始制作。

entries.Original: Artisan will not start crafting if you do not meet this minimum control with this macro selected.
entries.Translated: 如果选择这个宏时不满足这个最小控制，工匠将不会开始制作。

entries.Original: Artisan will not start crafting if you do not meet this minimum CP with this macro selected.
entries.Translated: 如果选择这个宏时未达到最低 CP，工匠将不会开始制作。

entries.Original: Insert New Action - Same As Previous (
entries.Translated: 插入新动作——与之前相同 (

entries.Original: Uses a recommendation from the appropriate default solver, i.e Standard Recipe Solver for regular recipes, Expert Recipe Solver for expert recipes.
entries.Translated: 使用来自相应默认求解器的建议，即常规配方的标准配方求解器和专家配方求解器。

entries.Original: This will use the appropriate step of the 3-step touch combo, depending on the last action actually used. Useful if upgrading quality actions or skipping on conditions.
entries.Translated: 这将使用三步触摸组合中的适当步骤，具体取决于实际使用的最后一个动作。如果需要升级质量操作或跳过条件，这个方法很有用。

entries.Original: Similar to the other touch combo, this will alternate between Basic Touch & Refined Touch depending on the previous action used.
entries.Translated: 与其他触控组合类似，这将根据之前使用的动作在基本触控和精细触控之间切换。

entries.Original:
You can either copy/paste macros directly as you would a normal game macro, or list each action on its own per line.
For example:
/ac Muscle Memory

is the same as

Muscle Memory

You can also use * (asterisk) or 'Artisan Recommendation' to insert Artisan's recommendation as a step.
entries.Translated:
您可以像直接复制/粘贴普通游戏宏一样直接复制/粘贴宏，或者每行单独列出每个动作。
例如：
/ac 肌肉记忆

等同于

肌肉记忆

您也可以使用 *(星号) 或 “工匠推荐” 来插入工匠推荐作为步骤。

entries.Original: This tab will allow you to add macros that Artisan can use instead of its own decisions. Once you create a new macro, click on it from the list below to open up the macro editor window for your macro.
entries.Translated: 这个选项卡允许你添加 Artisan 可以使用的宏，而不是它自己的决定。创建新的宏后，从下面的列表中单击它，打开宏编辑器窗口。

entries.Original: Crafting in progress. Macro settings will be unavailable until you stop crafting.
entries.Translated: 正在进行手工制作。宏设置将不可用，直到您停止手工制作。
从剪贴板导入宏 (手工导出)

entries.Original: Reorder Mode (Click and Drag to Reorder)
entries.Translated: 重新排序模式 (点击并拖动以重新排序)

entries.Original: Listen buddy, you're on Dalamud staging, there's every chance any problems you might encounter is specific to Dalamud's testing and not Artisan. I don't make this plugin to work on staging, so don't expect any fixes unless the problem makes it to Dalamud release.
entries.Translated: 听着，伙计，你现在正在测试 Darumud，你可能遇到的任何问题都很可能是针对 Darumud 测试的，而不是 Artisan。我制作这个插件不是为了在测试阶段工作，所以不要指望任何修复，除非问题导致 Darumud 发布。

entries.Original: I would first like to thank you for downloading my little crafting plugin. I have been working on Artisan consistently since June 2022 and it's my magnum opus of a plugin.
entries.Translated: 首先，我要感谢您下载了我的小型制作插件。自 2022 年 6 月以来，我一直在坚持不懈地制作 Artisan，这是我的杰作插件。

entries.Original: Before you get started with Artisan, we should go over a few things about how the plugin works. Artisan is simple to use once you understand a few key factors.
entries.Translated: 在开始使用 Artisan 之前，我们应该先了解一些关于插件工作原理的知识。一旦你理解了几个关键因素，Artisan 就变得简单易用了。

entries.Original: Artisan features an "Automatic Action Execution Mode" which merely takes the suggestions provided to it and performs the action on your behalf. By default, this will fire as fast as the game allows, which is faster than normal macros. You are not bypassing any sort of game restrictions doing this, however you can set a delay should you choose to. Enabling this has nothing to do with the suggestion making process Artisan uses by default.
entries.Translated: Artisan 提供了一个 “自动操作执行模式”，它只接受提供给它的建议，并代表你执行操作。默认情况下，它会以游戏允许的最快速度触发，这比普通宏要快。你这样做并没有绕过任何游戏限制，但如果你选择，你可以设置延迟。启用这个功能与 Artisan 默认使用的建议执行过程无关。

entries.Original: If you do not have the automatic mode enabled, you will have access to 2 more modes. "Semi-Manual Mode" and "Full Manual". "Semi-Manual Mode" will appear in a small pop-up window when you start crafting.
entries.Translated: 如果您没有启用自动模式，您将可以访问另外 2 种模式。“半手动模式” 和 “全手动模式”。当您开始制作时，“半手动模式” 将出现在一个小的弹出窗口中。

entries.Original: By clicking the "Execute recommended action" button, you are instructing the plugin to perform the suggestion it has recommended. This considered semi-manual as you still have to click each action, but you don't have to worry about finding them on your hotbars. "Full-Manual" mode is performed by pressing the buttons on your hotbar as normal. You are provided with an aid by default as Artisan will highlight the action on your hotbar if it is slotted. (This can be disabled in the settings)
entries.Translated: 通过点击 “执行建议的操作” 按钮，你指示插件执行它推荐的建议。这被认为是半手动操作，因为你仍然需要点击每个操作，但你不必担心在热量条上找到它们。“全手动” 模式通过正常按下热量条上的按钮来执行。默认情况下，你会获得一个辅助功能，因为如果热量条上的操作处于插槽状态，Artisan 会突出显示该操作。(这可以在设置中禁用)

entries.Original:
Artisan by default will provide you with suggestions on what your next crafting step should be. This solver is not perfect however and it is definitely not a substitute for having appropriate gear. You do not need to do anything to enable this behaviour other than have Artisan enabled. 

If you are trying to tackle a craft that the default solver cannot craft, Artisan allows you to build macros which can be used as the suggestions instead of the default solver. Artisan macros have the benefit of not being restricted in length, can fire off as fast as the game allows and also allows some additional options to tweak on the fly.
entries.Translated:
默认情况下，Artisan 会为你提供建议，告诉你下一步应该做什么。然而，这个解决方案并不完美，也绝对不是拥有合适设备的替代品。除了启用 Artisan 之外，你不需要做任何事情来启用这种行为。

如果你试图解决一个默认求解器无法完成的工艺，Artisan 允许你构建宏，这些宏可以用作建议，而不是默认求解器。Artisan 宏的优点是长度不受限制，可以在游戏允许的范围内尽快触发，并且还允许一些额外的选项随时进行调整。

entries.Original: Click here to be taken to the Macro menu.

Once you have created a macro, you will have to assign it to a recipe. This is easily accomplished by using the Recipe Window dropdown. By default, this is attached to the top right of the in-game crafting log window but can be unattached in the settings.
entries.Translated: 创建宏后，你需要将其分配给一个菜谱。这很容易通过使用菜谱窗口下拉菜单来完成。默认情况下，这个菜谱窗口会附加到游戏内制作日志窗口的右上角，但在设置中可以不附加。

entries.Original: Select a macro you have created from the dropdown box. When you go to craft this item, the suggestions will be replaced by the contents of your macro.
entries.Translated: 从下拉框中选择您创建的宏。当您开始创建这个项目时，建议将被您宏的内容所替换。

entries.Original:
Artisan has a mode titled "Endurance Mode" which is basically a fancier way of saying "Auto-repeat mode" which will continually try to craft the same item for you. Endurance Mode works by selecting a recipe from the in-game crafting log and enabling the feature. Your character will then attempt to keep crafting that item as many times as you have materials for it. 

The other features should hopefully be self-explanatory as Endurance Mode can also manage the usage of your food, potions, manuals, repairs and materia extraction between crafts. The repair feature only supports repairing with dark matter and does not support repair NPCs.
entries.Translated:
Artisan 有一个名为 “耐力模式” 的模式，这基本上是 “自动重复模式” 的一种更花哨的说法，它会不断尝试为你制作相同的道具。耐力模式的工作方式是从游戏内的制作日志中选择一个配方并启用该功能。然后，你的角色会尝试不断制作该道具，直到你有足够的材料为止。

其他功能应该不言而喻，因为耐力模式也可以管理你的食物、药剂、手册、修复和物质提取在不同职业之间的使用。修复功能只支持暗物质修复，不支持修复 NPC。

entries.Original: Click here to be taken to the Endurance menu.
entries.Translated: 点击此处进入 “耐力” 菜单。

entries.Original: Artisan also has the ability to create a list of items and have it start crafting each of them, one after another, automatically. Crafting lists have a lot of powerful tools to streamline the process of going from materials to final products. It also supports importing and exporting to Teamcraft.
entries.Translated: Artisan 还有能力创建一个物品列表，并让它开始自动制作每一个物品，一个接一个。制作列表拥有许多强大的工具，可以简化从材料到最终产品的过程。它还支持进出口到 Teamcraft。

entries.Original: Crafting lists are a fantastic way to queue up different crafts and have them craft one-by-one. Create a list by importing from Teamcraft using the button at the bottom, or click the '+' icon and give your list a name.

entries.Original: This section is for building lists based on certain criteria rather than individually. Give your list a name and select your criteria from below then select "Build List" and a new list will be created with all items that match the criteria. If you do not select any checkboxes then that category will be treated as "Any" or "All" except for which job crafts it.
entries.Translated: 本节适用于基于特定标准而非个别标准构建列表。为您的列表命名，并从下方选择您的标准，然后选择 “构建列表”，将创建一个新的列表，其中包含所有符合标准的项目。如果您没有选择任何复选框，该类别将被视为 “任何” 或 “所有”，除非是由特定作业创建。

entries.Original:
Guide to importing lists.

Step 1. Open a list on Teamcraft with the items you wish to craft.

Step 2. Find the pre crafts section and click the "Copy as Text" button.

Step 3. Paste into the Pre-Craft Items box in this window.

Step 4. Repeat Step 2 & 3 but for the final items section.

Step 5. Give your list a name and click import.
entries.Translated:
导入列表指南。

第一步：在 Teamcraft 上打开一个清单，列出你想要制作的物品。

第二步：找到预制品部分，然后点击 “复制为文本” 按钮。

第三步：将其粘贴到此窗口中的 “预制道具” 框中。

第四步：重复第二步和第三步，但最终项目部分除外。

第五步：给列表命名，然后点击 “导入”。

entries.Original: These items will try to be added as quick synth due to the default setting being enabled.
entries.Translated: 由于启用了默认设置，这些项目将尝试作为快速合成器添加。

entries.Original: Endurance mode is Artisan's way to repeat the same craft over and over, either so many times or until you run out of materials. It has full capabilities to automatically repair your gear once a piece is under a certain percentage, use food/potions/exp manuals and extract materia from spiritbonding. Please note these settings are independent of crafting list settings, and only intended to be used to craft the one item repeatedly.
entries.Translated: 耐久模式是工匠反复重复相同工艺的方式，可以重复多次，也可以直到材料耗尽为止。它具有完整的功能，一旦一件装备低于一定比例，就能自动修复您的装备，使用食物/药剂/经验说明书，并从灵魂绑定中提取材料。请注意，这些设置与工艺列表设置无关，仅用于反复制作同一件物品。

entries.Original: You cannot start Endurance as you do not possess ingredients to craft this recipe.

entries.Original:
In order to begin Endurance Mode crafting you should first select the recipe in the crafting menu.
Endurance Mode will automatically repeat the selected recipe similar to Auto-Craft but will factor in food/medicine buffs before doing so.
